items.title: Automatic touchpad repair engine at every start (navin-touchpad-repair.service)
Repair runs only safe steps for the exact problem and reports success only after a new hardware scan
Touchpad found in basic PS/2 mode (vendor driver failed) is now recognised and controlled
Kernel log check: lost sync, ELAN/Synaptics/ALPS failures, SMBus, missing PS/2 port, I2C-HID, firmware, ACPI errors
Touchpad Control Center in Settings with AUTO DETECT & REPAIR TOUCHPAD and FORCE HARDWARE RESCAN
Real settings: on/off, speed, acceleration, tap, tap-and-drag, two-finger/edge scrolling, natural scrolling, right-click method, disable while typing, middle click, left-handed
Touchpad performance modes: fast response, smooth movement, restore optimal
Touchpad hardware test counts only real events from the touchpad device
Touchpad driver tools: information, reload module, update, reinstall, roll back, restore default, logs
Touchpad on/off keys (XF86TouchpadOn/Off) besides the toggle key
After sleep the touchpad is checked once and repaired only if it did not come back
Fan diagnosis: Samsung silent mode, disabled thermal zones, missing ACPI fan or temperature driver, overheating
Samsung performance level follows the fan mode (silent / normal, never overclock)
Diagnose & repair fan button and fan logs
Touchpad & Fan Troubleshooter: quick/full scan, repair wizards, thermal and kernel input diagnostics, report export
NAVIN AI Doctor finds touchpad and fan problems and offers the real repair
ISO size guard: the ISO must stay under 2 GB
